title: Operations Manager
description:
About

Recess Pickleball is a startup based in Austin, TX. We are a rapidly growing lifestyle brand that manufactures and sells pickleball equipment. We have a bold vision to be THE brand in the fastest growing sport in America. We are a small and growing team that enjoys staying active, trying new things, and having a good time. We are looking for ambitious and scrappy self-starters to join our team.

As an Operations Manager you will work directly with our COO to help scale the Recess operations function. You will have the opportunity to impact every part of the Recess business including sales ops, customer experience, design to delivery workflows, and more. This role is ideal for an extremely organized individual who enjoys working cross functionally to manage processes against deadlines. As an early employee of Recess Pickleball you will also have the chance to help shape the culture of the company.

Responsibilities

  • Work closely with the COO to streamline and buildout key operations processes

  • Identify areas for process improvement, develop actionable improvement plans, and independently drive improvement projects to completion

  • Coordinate with sales to manage the production schedule of our Custom paddles made in Austin

  • Manage select inventory levels and work with suppliers to reorder key pickleball paddle components

  • Manage special projects ranging from Amazon inventory replenishments to outbound logistics optimizations

  • Own customer success metrics including CSAT, and work with CX manager to improve our level of support

  • Work collaboratively with the other members of the Operations team to improve day-to-day operations

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of professional experience in an operations function or with early stage startups

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, industrial engineering, or related field

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and Google collaboration software (e.g. Google Sheets)

  • Experience with Shopify, inventory mgmt solutions, and other operations software preferred but not required

  • Strong organization skills and an extreme attention to detail

  • Strong communications skills and desire to work cross functionally

  • Excitement for startups and building from the ground up

  • Comfortable working in a relatively unstructured environment

  • Collaborative work style with a passion for play and our mission!
